description: Source code for a Zephyr driver implementing mailbox communication via Andes Technology's PLIC software interrupt mechanism.

methods.name: plic_sw_irq_set_pending
methods.description: Sets the pending status of a software interrupt for a given device and IRQ.

methods.name: is_channel_valid
methods.description: Checks if a given channel number is within the maximum allowed.

methods.name: mbox_andes_init
methods.description: Initializes the mailbox driver, sets up IRQ handling.

methods.name: andes_plic_sw_irq_handler
methods.description: Handles software interrupt from PLIC, invokes registered callback.
